You have been hired by the Crown to escort one of their representatives to some derelict country manor called Mortus Mansion.
Not being choosy about where your gold comes from, you agreed to their generous terms.
Your first stop will be the nearby village of Fendringham, quite a ride from Lake Libra, giving you plenty of time to ponder the job.
res://timelines/textures/coach.png
The road to Fendringham is a narrow, ragged thing. Neglect and lack of traffic have allowed the wilderness to choke the old road into the rough path the coach is attempting to navigate.
You and the Crown agent feel like a pair of dice as the coach shakes and rattles from traversing the uneven ground.
Despite that, the fellow tries their best to make conversation, if only to make the trip more bearable.
'What do you suppose happened to the fellow we sent? Could there be something lurking in the Mansion, I wonder?'
Agree
Disagree
Shrug
res://timelines/textures/inn.png
At last, you arrive at Fendringham, just as night falls. The coaching inn is larger than you expected, but your coach is only one of two on the grounds.
Normally, you would wait to set up a base of operations at a larger settlement, but Fendringham is the closest village to the mansion in a sparsely populated area.
'We should see to getting a room and somewhere to safely stow our gear. Gathering information wouldn't hurt either,' ventures your partner.
'Would you mind having a look around while I arrange for room and board?'
